precommitted_t1_rule.speed_survival: The controlled shared-minus-offtrunk correlation gap must be positive, its pair bootstrap 95% CI must exclude 0, and it must retain at least 50% of the raw gap.
precommitted_t1_rule.lead_lag: At least 25% of pairs must have a significant non-zero-lag cross-correlation peak (permutation p<0.05) or the signed net transfer-entropy asymmetry must exceed its pair-shuffle 95% null.
precommitted_t1_rule.verdict: If both tests pass: coupling survives common-shock controls. If neither passes: largely common-shock. Otherwise: mixed.
